tagline.en_US: A standalone log database with built-in ingestion APIs and a query UI. It stores logs on a persistent data volume and does not require a database, collector or other service to start; a separate collector is needed to send it logs.

description.en_US: VictoriaLogs is a lightweight, schema-free database designed for logs. It handles log storage and querying, scaling from small setups to large deployments. It includes a built-in web interface for exploring log data and integrates with visualization tools like Grafana.
